final.role: Model-definition framework to run and train ML models (text, vision, audio); usable to run embedding and reranker models locally
final.evidence: Transformers acts as the model-definition framework for state-of-the-art machine learning ... for both inference and training; Apache License 2.0 header; pip install transformers[torch]

auditoria.nota: General ML runtime; matters to the hub only as the engine behind a local embedding or reranker model, not as a search layer.
